about: Field Books 5 to 10 of 24: the six found in the Crescent Holds in the first hour. Lore only, in W1's shape: one ruled page in Plex Mono (lines already broken, at most 58 characters), a sketch for the page's corner, and the single mark it inks on the map. 'loading' is the one line the Loading screen may show.

books.title: LEVEL BOOK 12 · HOLDS
books.hand: a leveller of the Datum Survey
books.found: in a tin under the spoil berm, ten paces up the Scar from Benchmark 1
page: Benchmark 1 of the south ash. Bronze, flush, arrow up.
Set in a basalt block 0.6 m deep. It will not walk.
Bearings from the stud: the Organ Shelf pillar,
the Rise pillar, the Ring. Three rays, one point.
Closed to 4 seconds of arc. Hale wanted 3.
Nothing stands here but the ash and us.
Elevation 55.9 above the Datum.
Whatever is built here after today is built
on a number, and the number is this one.
Lunch in the lee of the cart. Wind from 045, warm.
books.sketch: a bronze stud with a broad arrow, three rays fanning from it toward three tiny pillars
books.loading: Whatever is built here after today is built on a number.

books.title: WALL BOOK OF NINEWALLS
books.hand: a builder of the first crescent
books.found: in the niche of the third wall, behind the salt
page: First wall laid this spring, 9 courses, dry,
facing the trade. 26 m round on the inside.
Behind it 40 pits, a vine in each, one fig.
The wind lost its teeth the day we capped it.
The ash holds the night's dew if the wind
does not get at it. That is the whole secret.
A Plumb came at the new moon and stood
a whole night on the ridge with its lamp on us.
In the morning there was red paint on the wall,
a hand high off the ground. We left it.
Next spring the second wall, 4 m out.
books.sketch: a crescent of dry stone in section, a vine root curling under it, a thumb-width stripe of red on its face

inks.what: the niche on the third wall's inner face

books.loading: The wind lost its teeth the day we capped it.

books.title: TALLY OF A HERD
books.found: pressed in a seed bag, dropped on the herd's slope
page: Five Tillers today. Same bearing as yesterday.
Core every 3 paces, never 2, never 4.
I counted 212 cores to the ridge.
One seed to a core. 212 seeds.
Mother says count the ones that come up.
Last year 61 of 190. This year more rain.
The big one in front never stops.
The little one at the back stops to scratch.
I do not think they scratch. I think it is a seal.
Walked in its lee all the way. The Plumb on the
terrace never once put its lamp on me.
books.sketch: five hulls in file on a slope, a row of dots between them, one small figure walking in their shadow

inks.what: the herd's slope below the terrace

books.loading: Walked in its lee all the way.

books.title: WHAT THE SCREED DID
books.hand: a pit farmer of the lower terraces
books.found: on a slate under the berm where the Scar meets the barranco
page: It came up from the coast in one line and did not
turn for a house, a pit or a goat.
25 m wide. Straight. It cut to a height only it knew
and left the spoil in two banks either side.
Six families lost their pits. The vines are under
the left bank. You can dig and find them.
It never looked at us. Nobody was hurt
who got out of the way. That is the worst of it:
it was not trying to hurt anyone.
480 m and then it stopped, and walked off east.
books.sketch: a straight band across contour lines, two dashed banks either side, a tiny house split by the band's edge

inks.what: where the Scar meets the barranco

books.loading: It was not trying to hurt anyone.

books.title: LEVEL BOOK 13 · THE TUBE
books.hand: a leveller of the Datum Survey
books.found: on the pool ledge in the Jameo, under a fallen block
page: The skylight is 103 m above the Datum at its rim.
The pool under it is level with the sea
to the millimetre, and rises with the tide.
The tube runs 140 m to the mouth below the Rise.
Dry, cool, 3 m high. Somebody will live in it.
White crabs in the pool, blind, no bigger
than a thumbnail. They do not run from the lamp.
No benchmark here. The ground is honest.
B4 goes on the rim, where the light is.
books.sketch: a round hole in the ground in section, a pool at its foot, a tunnel running off to one side, one tiny crab

inks.what: the pool ledge in the Jameo

books.loading: The pool under it is level with the sea, to the millimetre.

books.title: THE SMITH'S WEIGHTS
books.hand: a tube smith of Ninewalls, three before Oro
books.found: on the shelf over the trough at the tube mouth
page: One bar of bronze: 30 salt in the dry season,
40 when the pans are under water.
A gaff head: 2 bars and a day.
A Windwall: 9 slats of pine, palm between,
a rivet you could hang a door on.
Brine pot: clay, a cup of the Pans' brine,
a cork. Throw it on anything that turns
and it will turn slower.
The Screeds come every forty years or so.
Keep the gaffs sharp in the years between.
books.sketch: a balance with a bronze bar on one pan and a heap of salt on the other, a gaff head on the bench below
books.loading: Keep the gaffs sharp in the years between.
